scope: One bounded live Sentinel-2 RGB crop, not SR fidelity validation.

provenance.provider: Element 84 Earth Search / public Sentinel COG archive
provenance.bands: RGB true-color display based on Sentinel-2 B04/B03/B02; provider-stretched uint8, not reflectance
provenance.cloud_filter: Scene-level only; not a pixel cloud mask
provenance.crop_note: Fixed-size native-pixel crop centered on the AOI/scene intersection; not the full AOI extent.
provenance.invalid_pixel_handling: Invalid source pixels are displayed black; PNG/JPEG exports do not retain the mask.
provenance.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; Element 84 COG archive
provenance.calibration: Display RGB only; no reflectance-calibrated or multispectral processing.
provenance.processing_level: L2A source (atmospherically corrected); selected visual product is display encoded.
provenance.quality_limitation: NAIP-trained SR pilots applied cross-sensor; Sentinel reconstruction fidelity unvalidated.
